title: 生成式 AI 生产率实证研究
title_en: Empirical studies of generative AI and productivity
notes: 效应为各研究报告的百分比，须线表示原文给出的 95% 置信区间（客服研究为本站推算）。QJE 与 Science 正式版的区间单位分别为“每小时解决问题数”和“标准差”，与百分比轴不同，只在详情中以文字给出、不画须线。各研究的任务、样本与指标不同，不可直接横向比较。
notes_en: Effects are the percentages reported by each study; whiskers show the 95% confidence intervals given in the original papers (derived by this site for the customer-support study). The intervals for the published QJE and Science versions are in “resolutions per hour” and “standard deviations” rather than percentages, so they appear as text in the details only, without whiskers. Tasks, samples and metrics differ across studies, so they cannot be compared directly.

records.design: 在一家企业分阶段引入生成式 AI 助手，比较引入前后与未引入者的工作效率（工作论文版本）。
records.design_en: A generative AI assistant was rolled out in stages at one company; productivity was compared before and after rollout and against agents without access (working paper version).
records.version_note: QJE 2025 正式版为 5,172 名客服、平均提升 15%。
records.version_note_en: The published QJE 2025 version reports 5,172 agents and an average gain of 15%.
records.ci_note: 本站由论文表 2 首选设定系数 0.138、标准误 0.0199 推算（log 点换算为百分比）
records.ci_note_en: Derived by this site from the paper's preferred specification in Table 2 (coefficient 0.138, standard error 0.0199), converting log points to percentages

records.short: 客服 · 新手与低技能
records.design: 同上研究中新手和低技能员工子样本。
records.design_en: Subsample of novice and low-skilled workers in the same study.

records.version_note: 与工作论文 14% 存在差异。
records.version_note_en: Differs from the 14% in the working paper.
records.ci_note: 本站由 QJE 正式版主规格系数 0.301、标准误 0.0329 按 ±1.96 倍标准误计算，论文未直接列出区间；单位为每小时解决问题数（绝对值），不是百分比
records.ci_note_en: Computed by this site from the main-specification coefficient (0.301) and standard error (0.0329) of the published QJE version as ±1.96 standard errors; the paper does not list the interval itself. Units are resolutions per hour (absolute), not percentages

records.metric: 完成 HTTP 服务器任务的速度
records.metric_en: Speed of completing an HTTP server task
records.design: 随机对照实验：实验组可用 GitHub Copilot，用 JavaScript 实现 HTTP 服务器。
records.design_en: Randomised controlled experiment: the treatment group could use GitHub Copilot to implement an HTTP server in JavaScript.

records.short: 写作 · 完成时间缩短
records.design: 预注册在线实验：中级专业写作任务，随机分配 ChatGPT 使用权。
records.design_en: Pre-registered online experiment: mid-level professional writing tasks, with access to ChatGPT randomly assigned.
records.ci_note: Science 正式版图中的标准化效应及 95% 置信区间；单位为标准差，不是百分比
records.ci_note_en: Standardised effect and 95% confidence interval shown in a figure of the published Science version; units are standard deviations, not percentages

records.design_en: Quality ratings from the same experiment.
records.ci_note: Science 正式版图中的标准化效应及 95% 置信区间；单位为标准差，不是百分比
records.ci_note_en: Standardised effect and 95% confidence interval shown in a figure of the published Science version; units are standard deviations, not percentages

records.sample_unit: 名资深开发者（246 个真实任务）
records.design: 随机对照试验：主要使用 Cursor Pro + Claude 3.5/3.7 Sonnet，在自己熟悉的大型开源仓库中完成真实任务。
records.design_en: Randomised controlled trial: developers mainly used Cursor Pro + Claude 3.5/3.7 Sonnet to complete real tasks in large open-source repositories they knew well.
records.version_note: 反例：使用 AI 工具后耗时反而增加。
records.version_note_en: Counter-example: using AI tools actually increased completion time.
